verdict.rationale: AWS's free page states the terms plainly: new Free Tier accounts get $100 in credits immediately and can earn up to $100 more, for up to $200 over 6 months. It also says there are no charges on the Free plan unless you convert to a Paid plan, so the credit limit and expiry are spelled out. A community comment separately mentions 95GB of free egress, which hints at an always-free allowance. missing for 10: documented always-free per-service limits, a published startup-specific credits program (e.g. limits and eligibility for founders), independent hands-on corroboration of the $200/6-month plan.
